6	def parse_line(line, delimiter=","):
7	    """Split LINE into fields, stripped of spaces."""
8	    fields = line.rstrip("\n").split(delimiter)
9	    if fields and fields[-1].strip() == "":
10	        fields.pop()
11	    return [field.strip() for field in fields]

14	def read_records(path, delimiter=","):
15	    """Yield the fields of each line of PATH.
16	
17	    Blank lines and lines starting with # are
18	    skipped."""
19	    with Path(path).open(encoding="utf-8") as f:
20	        for line in f:
21	            if line.strip() and line[0] != "#":
22	                yield parse_line(line, delimiter)

"""Print the records of a file, one per line, tab-separated."""

import argparse

from reader import read_records


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("path", help="file to read")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    for record in read_records(args.path):
        print("\t".join(record))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
